column6: Winter Buckeye Trail 50k — Part 2 of the weekend double
column99: Mission success! Ran a weekend negative split, chopping off 10 minutes from yesterday's time. Took it super easy to warm-up, tried to keep the HR under 140 for the 1st 15, slowly allowed that to creep a little. Last 5 miles, I pushed harder than all weekend to ensure I came in faster. The course was quite a bit more challenging than Regis, from the surface to the steeper and loner climbs. No complaints. What a great weekend!

column6: Run for Regis 50k 2016 — First run of the weekend double
column99: Took it super easy, as I get to run again tomorrow at the Winter Buckeye Trail 50k. Ran the whole thing with Steph from Youngstown, first 15 with Angela, Felicia and Rob. column6: Trail Blazing — Happy Days to Crawdad Corner
column99: Pretty much got the trail route set now. From Happy Days trailhead, cross Boston Run, then head down the stream following on the North Side. Head up the slope to Green Trail, then back down to Pump House. Head back to Red Trail, to the end of the big spur, then down to Confluence. Follow Boston Run to Crawdad Corner. Next week, we'll try and run the whole thing, Pine Lance to Happy Days and get a good idea of the real distance, and if any sections need much changing. There are couple of spots that aren't switch backed right, so we'll see if we change them. The Trail from HD to Crawdad is nicely marked with yellow tape.
